reason: The patch changes packages/app-store/index.ts:87-114 so every app is loaded with an eager `import("./x")` when the module is evaluated, and nothing attaches a handler to those promises until a consumer awaits that key (e.g. getCalendar.ts:17, videoClient.ts:247). A failing import therefore rejects with no handler and raises unhandledRejection, where the old static `import * as` made the importing module fail to load with an ordinary import error.
